# Python packages installed on top of the NGC TensorFlow 23.09 base image by
# thor.recipe. Kept in sync with that recipe by hand.
#
# This file exists for two purposes:
#   1. a readable record of the pinned versions;
#   2. staging wheels for an offline build, where the build host has no
#      outbound network:
#
#        # on a node with internet:
#        pip download -d wheelhouse -r requirements.txt \
#            --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu118
#        # then in %post:
#        pip install --no-index --find-links=/wheelhouse -r /requirements.txt
#
# Not a standalone environment: TensorFlow, numpy, h5py, scipy and the CUDA
# runtime come from the base image and are deliberately NOT listed here.
# Installing this file into a bare environment will not give you a working
# THOR; build the container instead.

# --- constraint ------------------------------------------------------------
# TensorFlow 2.13.0+nv23.9 requires numpy<=1.24.3 and the base image's numba
# requires numpy<1.25. Several packages below will pull numpy 1.26 unless held.
numpy<1.25

# --- TensorFlow side -------------------------------------------------------
# tensorflow-addons is deliberately NOT listed: THOR never constructs tfa
# layers, it has no aarch64 wheels, and it reached end of life in May 2024.
# See src/utils/tfa_compat.py.
tensorboard-plugin-profile==2.13.0

# --- PyTorch (CUDA 11.8 wheels, to match the base) -------------------------
# Needs: --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu118
torch==2.1.2
torchvision==0.16.2
torchaudio==2.1.2

# --- HuggingFace stack (ESM-1v) --------------------------------------------
# Install these together: resolving them separately lets huggingface-hub drift
# past the <1.0 ceiling transformers 4.41.2 requires.
transformers==4.41.2
tokenizers==0.19.1
huggingface-hub==0.23.2
datasets==2.20.0
accelerate==0.33.0

# --- Project dependencies ---------------------------------------------------
biopython
pandas
PyYAML
matplotlib
scikit-learn
simple_pid
tqdm
# 2.x: utils/layers_new.py and utils/layers_residual.py use the typeguard 2.x
# @typechecked decorator, whose signature changed in 4.x.
typeguard==2.12.1

# --- cuDNN matching the TF build -------------------------------------------
nvidia-cudnn-cu11==8.9.5.30
